stem.text: In the circuits shown, the temperature remains constant.
In which circuit does the potential difference (p.d.) $V$ increase with increasing light intensity?

A.alt: Circuit with a cell, two components in series and a voltmeter V across the upper component; the upper component has a thermistor symbol and the lower component is a fixed resistor.

B.alt: Circuit with a cell, two components in series and a voltmeter V across the upper component; the upper component has a light-dependent resistor symbol and the lower component is a fixed resistor.

C.alt: Circuit with a cell, two components in series and a voltmeter V across the upper component; the upper component has a light-dependent resistor symbol and the lower component has a thermistor symbol.

D.alt: Circuit with a cell, two components in series and a voltmeter V across the upper component; the upper component has a thermistor symbol and the lower component has a light-dependent resistor symbol.
